'''January 2001 Minneapolis tournament (9 January)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota on 9 January 2001. [[Joshua Grace]] won it. It is known from Garrett Larson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1611">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-10-mirkwood-deadbody-styled1611/ mirkwood-deadbody-style], DeckTech (garrett "deadbody" larson, 10 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-10-mirkwood-deadbody-styled1611/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 9 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Joshua Grace]]
